fills.researcher_notes: Same company-level answer as P3300, applied here per the brief's instruction to settle this once per system: Intergas Central Asia JSC operates the Kazakh Saryarka system under a lease from owner AstanaGaz KMG JSC. Evidence: KMG's 2019-10-09 press release announcing the post-commissioning lease to «Интергаз Центральная Азия», corroborated independently by Intergas's own corporate site listing «МГ «Сарыарка»» under its Kyzylorda UMG branch. Applied to this Phase II row on the basis that operatorship attaches to the trunk system, not per phase; Phase II is a downstream continuation of the same Kyzylorda-Astana-Kokshetau corridor Intergas already operates.

Sheet value (630) already correct; ref-add only. informburo.kz: 'Труба протяжённостью 276 км и диаметром 630 мм' for the Astana-Kokshetau (Phase II) section — length (276 km) also matches the sheet exactly. A second outlet's tech-library page (neftegaz.ru/tech-library/.../saryarka-gazoprovod) carries the same 630 mm figure per its indexed search snippet, but the live page renders as a JS single-page app that neither WebFetch nor a manual curl -sk fetch could extract text from (TLS chain error on WebFetch, and the raw HTML has no server-rendered article text) — so I could not independently verify it and it is NOT counted toward the tier or cited. Tier held at medium (one verified strong source) rather than high.
